sonnet.problem: The statement says Jesus 'answers' Simon's request by telling him not to be afraid. The text only has Jesus say 'Do not be afraid' after verse 9 (the astonishment of Simon, his companions, James and John). It never says this is a reply to 'Go away from me.' The card sets up a connection the text leaves open.
sonnet.rule: **Leave open what the text leaves open.** Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
